script: A wooden horse fooled an entire Nazi prison camp. At Stalag Luft III, three British prisoners built a gymnastics vaulting horse out of plywood and carried it out to the same spot every single day. Guards watched them vault over it for exercise and got bored of checking it. But here's the part nobody mentions: hidden inside was a man, digging a tunnel straight down through the sand, hour after hour, hidden by the wooden shell above him. For months, prisoners carried him out hidden inside, and carried the dug-up sand back inside hidden inside. And then it got even bolder: three men escaped through that tunnel and made it all the way home. The guards never once searched the horse. A wooden horse had fooled them the entire time.
